title: Configuration Modes
description: Navigate between global config, interface config, and other sub-modes.
scenario: Navigate through CLI modes step by step: enable, configure terminal, interface FastEthernet0/1, then end.

objectives.text: Enter interface configuration mode for FastEthernet0/1

concepts.title: CLI Mode Navigation
concepts.body: Navigate through CLI modes step by step: User EXEC (>) → Privileged EXEC (#) → Global Config (config)# → Interface Config (config-if)#. Use 'enable' to enter privileged, 'configure terminal' for global config, 'interface' for interface config, 'exit' to go back one level, 'end' to jump to privileged.
concepts.code:
Switch> enable
Switch# configure terminal
Switch(config)# interface FastEthernet0/1
Switch(config-if)# end
Switch#

concepts.title: Config Sub-modes
concepts.body: From global config (config)#, you can enter interface config (config-if)#, line config (config-line)#, VLAN config (config-vlan)#, and more.
concepts.code:
Switch# configure terminal
Switch(config)# interface FastEthernet0/1
Switch(config-if)#

concepts.title: Exiting Modes
concepts.body: "exit" goes back one level. "end" jumps directly to privileged EXEC. "Ctrl+Z" also exits to privileged.

concepts.title: Prompt Indicators
concepts.body: The prompt tells you which mode you are in: (config)#, (config-if)#, (config-line)#, (config-vlan)#.
